systems.country_label: "Mirchaye" voter registration system and Candidate Registration System
systems.platform: web, mobile application and election officers' tablets, using Fayda data
systems.tiers: selected polling stations; manual registration on physical registries in the remaining polling stations; inaugurated 5 January 2026

note: An electoral register, which the typology places out of scope with land and business registers; nothing on civil registration.
